proposals.evidence: Ordered honey + insect: DEDR3268(b) explicitly gives Kannada jēnu/tēnu honey and4312 Kannada puẓu/puẓa insect, corresponding to the Kannada h/u- form after regular initial weakening. The survey jenu/dzenu/ḍenu + uḷuvu/uḷā bee responses retain both lexical constituents; the generic insect word is not confused with the separate wood-worm entry700.

proposals.evidence: Ordered sesame + oil: DEDR854 explicitly gives Tamil eṇ ṇey gingelly oil and related Malayalam eṇṇa/Kannada eṇṇe, while3746 gives ney oil. These lexicalized eṇṇey/eṇṇa/eṇṇe survey responses are analysed with both historical constituents; their generalized survey gloss oil and all dialect transcriptions remain unchanged.

proposals.evidence: Ordered inside + hand: DEDR698 gives uḷ/uḷḷam inside/interior and2023 kai/kay hand. Survey uḷḷankai/aḷḷamkay/uḷḷāŋāy palm transparently combines the interior term and hand, with nasal sandhi retained. Current698 includes inside in its gloss; this use does not claim that the unrelated house responses belong there.
